author: Harry Jaggard
description:
The reality of building a long-term life around travel

In this episode, Chris Rodriguez • Travelwithchris and I interview OG travel vlogger Steve Yalo about the realities of building a life around full-time travel and content creation. We share our personal experiences and debates the best destinations across Southeast Asia for digital nomads, budget travelers, and first-time adventurers.
